nodes.title: 🆎 AusBoss
Describe the canvas
widgets_values: Describe this picture as it will look when finished, in 60 to 90 words. The flat mid-gray areas are blank space that will be painted to continue the scene: describe what naturally fills them, never call them gray, blank, empty or padding, and don't mention any tilt. Describe the subject, setting, materials, composition and lighting in plain factual language. Do not invent actions, camera motion or sound. Output only the description.

Describe the subject, setting, materials, composition and lighting in plain factual language. Do not invent actions, camera motion or sound. Output only the description.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Krea 2's text encoder reads the canvas, gray areas included, and describes the finished picture. Keep thinking on, or it can return nothing.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: The description comes first, then your line from What goes there. Together they are the prompt for the painting.

nodes.title: Krea 2 Outpaint Model Patch - Reference and placement
Stitch Inpaint - Put the new part back
Note
widgets_values: The canvas is the reference. Its mask marks the gray areas, so the sampler paints only there.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: 8 steps, CFG 1, er_sde and simple: the Krea 2 Turbo settings. The patch spreads the canvas reference over the whole frame.

nodes.title: Note
widgets_values: Your image goes back on top. Tone match shifts the new area's brightness and color to sit with your image along the seam.
